title: Removing embedded primes from a finite module
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M$ a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Among submodules $K\subseteq M$ whose support is nowhere dense in $\operatorname{Supp}(M)$ there is a maximal one. For $M'=M/K$, one has $\operatorname{Supp}(M')=\operatorname{Supp}(M)$, $M'$ has no embedded associated primes, and for every $f\in R$ contained in all embedded associated primes of $M$ the localization map gives $M_f\cong M'_f$.
